```bash

python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best

```

## Risk Note

With limited time remaining, prioritize **stability over gains**. The champion's -9.3% MDD and consistent fold performance make it the safer production candidate unless a new candidate demonstrably improves lockbox minimum without sacrificing tuning robustness.
